about: `rp init` (rpctl __main__.cmd_init) in $T/project/<cwd> after laying out project_files (a trailing / is a directory): exit status, stdout, stderr (a traceback's last line only), and every path under $T/project afterwards; HOME is $T/home, XDG_CONFIG_HOME $T/config

cases.name: a_fresh_folder
cases.stdout:
initialised project at $T/project
  .rpctl/ holds this project's transcripts and history
  the agent's file + shell tools operate on $T/project
  next: put RUNPOD_API_KEY in $T/config/rpctl/config
